name: taskdrop
description: TaskDrop — reverse-marketplace (Expo mobile + Next.js web + Supabase). Monorepo.

scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --project-id wjxvingpfbfvkfqhrguj --schema public > db.types.tmp && node -e "require('fs').renameSync('db.types.tmp','packages/db-types/src/database.types.ts')"
scripts.test:db: psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f supabase/tests/money_rules.test.sql -f supabase/tests/chat_access.test.sql -f supabase/tests/cancel_rules.test.sql -f supabase/tests/funding_rules.test.sql -f supabase/tests/withdrawal_rules.test.sql -f supabase/tests/rpc_surface.test.sql -f supabase/tests/column_lockdown.test.sql -f supabase/tests/audit_and_throttle.test.sql -f supabase/tests/admin_mfa.test.sql -f supabase/tests/age_gate.test.sql -f supabase/tests/copyright_takedowns.test.sql
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
